case.question: What Fahrenheit temperature is commonly used as a fever threshold?

retrieved.title: Retrieved 1: conflict_fever_1004f | Fever threshold correct
retrieved.text: A body temperature of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit, or 38 degrees Celsius, is commonly used as a fever threshold.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 2: conflict_fever_98f | Fever threshold conflict 98
retrieved.text: An incorrect note says 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit is the fever threshold.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 3: conflict_fever_105f | Fever threshold conflict 105
retrieved.text: A false chart lists 105 degrees Fahrenheit as the standard fever threshold.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 4: conflict_fever_celsius_distractor | Celsius conversion distractor
retrieved.text: Temperature can be converted between Fahrenheit and Celsius scales.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 5: missing_penicillin_medicine | Antibiotic medicines
retrieved.text: Antibiotics are medicines used to treat infections caused by susceptible bacteria.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 6: missing_penicillin_resistance | Antibiotic resistance
retrieved.text: Bacteria can evolve resistance when antibiotics are overused or used incorrectly.
